scope: Synthetic offline instructions, shared local service; never executed
limitations: Natural traffic is not controlled; contaminated rows are retained.
The first three baselines and default parallel-2 used only inventory warm-up; do not compare their cold solo goals as a slot effect.
Background fixtures bypass application optional-background admission for stress testing.
Timings exclude collecting observations and constructing the application prompt.
System RAM / GPU totals include other processes; sampled peaks can miss short spikes.
No p95 below twenty clean samples; validation is structural, not proof of gameplay success.

caveats: Observational and under synthetic benchmark stress, not paired A/B.
Baseline-before includes the attempted planning pause window.
Group by dispatch time; retain error/cancel/stale classifications, do not claim shared task IDs.
Latency and token medians use successful terminal outcomes; command latency requires command_ready.
Host adapter timing excludes upstream assembly, tools, speech and game execution; consumer backpressure can contribute.
Different tasks, inputs and durations; cannot attribute percentage changes solely to slots.
